name: v2.16.0
body:
## What's Changed
* (feat) Lambdaplex Connector by @petioptrv in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/7889
* feat(bitget): support LIMIT_MAKER (post-only) orders on both connectors by @isreallee82 in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8335
* (fix/perf) binance_perpetual: connector-review correctness & rate-limit fixes by @cardosofede in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8291
* fix: correct kucoin_perpetual trade stream WebSocket topic and timestamp field by @ipezygj in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8313
* Fix/ fix LP executor get_net_pnl_pct return value to conform with other executor by @mlguys in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8310
* Feat/improve candles feed by @cardosofede in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8304
* Feat/improve backpack by @cardosofede in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8323
* fix / resolve race condition in account readiness for websocket assist… by @vic-en in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8311
* fix / rate oracle treat USD as USDT-equivalent for balance conversions by @fengtality in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8328
* feat / `hbot` command-line interface (source + Docker) by @fengtality in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8337
* feat: remove Cube, AscendEx, and Vertex connectors by @fengtality in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8376
* (fix) Vertex testnet WS subscribe URL typo by @ipezygj in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8227
* fix(gateway): handle mint-address in order sizing and skip BudgetChecker for Gateway swaps by @fengtality in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8377
* fix / ensure candle requests always span at least one interval (fixes #8327) by @matthiola0 in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8338
* (fix) suppress GLOBAL_STOP_LOSS spam after position close in pmm_mister by @ybapat in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8348
* fix/order_executor: set position_close=True whenever self.config.position_action == PositionAction.CLOSE by @lgrawet in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8362
* Fix Hyperliquid perpetual order price quantization to exchange tick size by @chevoisiatesalvati in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8356
* fix(strategy_v2): full LP unwind, realized swap fills, and shutdown that preserves position holds by @fengtality in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8391
* fix(strategy_v2): preserve position exposure when executors time out during shutdown by @erickuhn19 in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8389
* Add Gemini exchange connector by @erickuhn19 in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8027
* fix(lp): close the position when an open fails after add_liquidity landed by @fengtality in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8395
* fix(lp): correct keep_position gating, position_hold accounting, and failed-open cleanup by @fengtality in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8394
* fix(backtesting): allow hyperliquid and hyperliquid_perpetual to be backtested by @fengtality in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8398
* fix/backpack_perp: correct available balance after fills (post-#8323) by @lgrawet in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8363
* fix: Pacifica connector crash on spot instruments and lost order fills by @dizpers in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8397

## New Contributors
* @ipezygj made their first contribution in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8227
* @matthiola0 made their first contribution in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8338
* @ybapat made their first contribution in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8348
* @chevoisiatesalvati made their first contribution in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8356
* @erickuhn19 made their first contribution in https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/pull/8389

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hummingbot/hummingbot/compare/v2.15.0...v2.16.0
